editorial_summary: This is a trendy cafe chain that sells high-quality coffee, pastries, coffee beans, and hand drip supplies.

reviews.author: Son Joo-il (Cecil)
reviews.text:
The experience at Blue Bottle Hannam branch was a high-quality experience that satisfied the brand's unique sensibility, spatial beauty, and the original taste of coffee.
The interior, which combines wide open windows, high ceilings, concrete and wood, gives you a sense of Blue Bottle's unique minimalism and sophistication at the same time. Natural light came in well, so the interior was filled with subtle warmth in the afternoon.​
Blue bottles, the brand symbol, are placed here and there to set the overall mood, and the interior lighting and trees visible beyond the window are naturally connected to the outside, creating a comfortable atmosphere without any sense of heterogeneity.​
There was ample space between seats to disperse noise well, and both the bar table and individual seats were comfortably placed.​
As expected, Blue Bottle Hannam's coffee exceeded expectations. The black, extracted by hand drip, had a rich flavor and a balanced bitterness and acidity.​
The latte came out beautifully with latte art on the crema, and the nutty flavor and soft texture went well with the subtle atmosphere of the Hannam branch.​
The blue bottle logo was clearly engraved all over the cup and plate, so I felt good even before drinking it, and even the coffee cup seemed like an extension of the interior.​
I was impressed by how friendly and skilled the staff was overall, from ordering to coffee extraction to table setting.​
The bar space is open, so you can see the extraction process up close, which gives you a high level of confidence in the coffee. Even during busy times, I felt relaxed response, and overall, it provides an impactful ‘Blue Bottle experience.’
Blue Bottle Hannam is a place where the quality of coffee, aesthetics of space, and sincerity of service all come together well. It's perfect for quietly opening a book or having a conversation, or just staying for a while to experience the brand.
The light comes in nicely for taking pictures, so it's perfect as a SNS cafe.

reviews.author: ace johnson
reviews.text: Although it looks spacious on the outside, the interior space is not that spacious and is a disconnected duplex structure. It's a space where they wanted to force a coffee shop into it, so it would be sophistry to push it in for emotional reasons. Anyway, appearance doesn't matter, let's move on to the coffee story. Personally, I lived in Australia, so I'm a flat white lover, so if it's on the menu, I'll definitely rush for a flat white. To digress for a moment, if you were to ask whether a latte and a flat white are different drinks in the first place, I think they are actually the same drink. To begin with, there are too many cases in Australia where there is no separate menu, so I think it is right to just see it as an Australian latte, but at some point, everyone started to divide the recipe based on the amount of milk and foam, and the number of restaurants serving it differently increased, so I think it is right to recognize it differently now, but because everyone's consensus is not completely consistent, there are still too many restaurants that use flat white and just serve latte. Of course, that doesn't mean this house is like that. However, it is always difficult because there are houses that vaguely walk that vague boundary, and this place was like that for me. Of course the coffee was delicious. It was a good balance with no flaws. However, if you only look at the appeal of flat white, it would be quite difficult to judge. I will use it a few more times and replenish.

reviews.text: Guinness 72 in Hannam-dong is a stylish pub where you can enjoy pizza and Guinness draft beer as a ‘perfect pairing.’ When you bite into a slice of the signature House Combi pizza filled with cheese on a thin, crispy dough, the savory and salty taste meets Guinness's unique creamy malt flavor and soft foam, waking up your mouth. Sides like truffle fries and scotch eggs are also top-notch. The interior is decorated with an Irish pub feel, and the music volume is moderate so there is no disruption to conversation. Staff service is fast and friendly, and draft beer is refilled quickly so your glass never runs out. Highly recommended as a second place for friends and lovers due to the high level of satisfaction compared to the price! It is open until midnight, and accessibility is good if you use the nearby public parking lot. If you are looking for the ‘Guinness + Pizza’ combination, put it on your must-visit list!

reviews.author: 首尔外围Outcall&Incall
reviews.text: This restaurant and bar located in Hannam-dong is truly impressive. The unique and sophisticated atmosphere combined with lighting and music creates the perfect dining environment for gatherings with friends. Manager Kari is incredibly attentive to detail, preparing birthday surprises for friends and even lending umbrellas to guests. The food is excellent quality and perfectly cooked, and the signature cocktails are a bit sweet but creative. However, the average price per person is somewhat high because electronic music is better suited to a casual meal rather than expensive wine and dancing. Overall, it is a place that exquisitely combines the atmosphere of a restaurant and a nightclub, providing service and food quality commensurate with the price. It offers a nightlife worth enjoying in Hannam-dong and is highly recommended for foodies.

reviews.author: Paulo André Marinho
reviews.text:
It was really great.

Lee (Kary) was a really great manager. They took great care of us and even prepared a small surprise for my friend who had a birthday. Moreover, another customer gave me his umbrella because he took mine by mistake. It was truly the greatest kindness. I will definitely visit again.

The food was really delicious too! All dishes were great.

The music was light and modern lounge techno, not suitable for dancing. But the atmosphere was really nice. I wonder what it will be like after Corona.

If you want to enjoy delicious food and drinks, you may want to consider paying around 100,000 won per person. All the food was really delicious.

The wine was a bit expensive, and the signature cocktail (smoky whiskey with lemon and berries) was a little too sweet for my taste. Other than that everything was great.

reviews.author: 首尔外围Outcall&Incall
reviews.text: Overall, this restaurant was a very good experience. The signature dish, braised pork belly, was really delicious. The marbling of fat and lean meat was perfect, and the texture melted in your mouth, making it truly fantastic when served with rice. The steamed sea bass was also fresh and perfectly cooked. The waiters were friendly and attentive, and the food came out quickly. The atmosphere was simple yet elegant, and there was ample space between tables and chairs. However, it was disappointing that it could be a bit noisy in the evening. The price was reasonable, and the portions were generous, making it great value for money. The only downside is that the location is a bit remote and parking space is limited. It's the perfect place for a family gathering or small gathering with friends, and I will definitely be visiting again. It would be nice if the restaurant would expand the parking space.
